official_frozen_baseline.scope: complete official fixed validation,2330maps/band; not hidden test
official_frozen_baseline.scorer: Reused previously verified unmodified official score_submission.py and metrics.py

official.scope: complete official fixed validation,2330maps/band; not hidden test
official.scorer: Reused previously verified unmodified official score_submission.py and metrics.py

package_timing_replay.input: raw released H and integer TX; targets and actual masks never opened by this script

transmitter_transfer.scope: Official TRAIN internal multi-TX terrains with >=10 distinct transmitters. Deduplicate H+TX, half the transmitters support and half query, swap halves. All variants with other TX labels are diagnostic-only.

selection.source: 48 TRAIN monitor terrains before checking confirmation

full_map_oracle_budget.scope: Actual C82 complete official fixed validation, no fitting; per-scale and common/differential decomposition over every valid pixel. Clear subsets only on the frozen uniform C78 panel of 2048 sites/map.

known_scene_primary_positive_control.scope: Official TRAIN only. Same registered mesh and Sionna 1.1.0 direct-only simulation. Evaluate certified interior unblocked points. Complete-case requires all weighted faces enumerated in every compared arm, per dataset and ray budget.
known_scene_primary_positive_control.positions: 2048 preselected without replacement per map; only certified clear retained

modes: +0.013 rad azimuth, same N, H, TX and measurement operator
targeted_4B_original_solver.eligibility: risk-stratified candidate widely certified locations >=65 m, target subsets only; not an official score

targeted_power_check.scope: 39 intentionally risk-stratified confirmation terrains, 1126 target pixels. Diagnostic only; these are not full-map scores. Constant gain shift relative to approximate first-order extra power.

examples.scope: Illustrations deliberately selected for contradictory ordering. Frequency estimates come only from the complete preselected panel, not from these cases.

score_scope: Published fixed validation, original masks, all 2330 maps/band on 680 terrains; not hidden test or Kaggle website.
research_scope: Only official TRAIN for new model selection/training and for the Sionna positive controls. Official validation only after freezing for C82 scoring and descriptive error budget.

runtime_cache.scope: Only runtime LLVM compiler entries; subsequent runs isolated using bwrap.

source: CC independent code plus official Sionna RT 1.1.0 for known scene controls. GPU work restricted to authorized UUIDs 1,3,4. No new neural training as part of C85/C86.
decision: Close local C76 residual corrections as the route to 1 dB; none of the new training branches met the major-effect threshold. Weak receiver location must transfer between intentionally perturbed and nominal physical scenes on unseen TRAIN terrain before another large run.
